purpose: Define the closed, bounded value vocabulary shared by every T025 unit: clock/timestamp/permit/session/controller identities plus the manager uniqueness scope, result codes, lifecycle states, actions, quotas, the field-locator enum, the payload-free Diagnostic value type, and the deterministic FNV-1a 128-bit content digest.
interfaces: using Timestamp = std::int64_t; using Tolerance = std::uint64_t; using SignedOffset = std::int64_t;
using ClockDomainId = std::uint32_t (0 reserved invalid); using Generation = std::uint64_t; using Nonce = std::uint64_t;

using ControllerId = std::array<std::uint8_t,16>; using ManagerScope = std::array<std::uint8_t,16>; using SessionId = std::array<std::uint8_t,16>; using PermitId = std::array<std::uint8_t,16>; using PlanDigest = std::array<std::uint8_t,32>;
enum class Action : std::uint32_t { Arm, Activate, Close, Finalize, Expire, Revoke, MarkEvidenceIncomplete }; using ActionMask = std::uint32_t;
enum class LifecycleState { declared, armed, active, closing, closed, expired, revoked, evidence_incomplete };
enum class QuotaKind { Operations, Evidence }; struct Quota { QuotaKind kind; std::uint32_t limit; };
enum class Result with the 27 outcomes of design §8.1 (InvalidHandle .. Ok, including InvalidController at rank 25);
enum class FieldLocator { SessionId, PlanDigest, Scenario, Deployment, Environment, Tool, Interface, Target, Nonce, AllowedActions, Validity, Quota };
struct Diagnostic: bounded ordered Result sequence (capacity 8) plus at most one optional numeric locator;
struct Tag: bounded printable-ASCII tag (<=63 bytes, no NUL) with validation;
constexpr bool is_terminal(LifecycleState); constexpr ActionMask defined_action_bits(ActionMask);
inputs: None. This is a pure value/type layer; its types are the inputs consumed by the owning units.
outputs: Shared value types and enums; canonical_digest() 128-bit digest; is_terminal(); defined_action_bits(); Diagnostic value.
state: None. No shared mutable state and no object identity.
errors: No runtime errors; value invariants are enforced by construction-time validation in the owning units.
invariants: ControllerId, ManagerScope, SessionId, and PermitId are 16 bytes; PlanDigest is 32 bytes.
ManagerScope is host-issued and non-zero per manager instance and recreation; it is bound into every issued session handle.
Tag is at most 63 bytes of printable ASCII with no NUL character.
ActionMask may contain only defined Action bits; composite masks are never implicitly decomposed into components.
Diagnostic holds only enumerable Result codes plus at most one numeric locator; no string, item, observation, or free-form content field.
canonical_digest is deterministic over identical byte sequences (FNV-1a, 128-bit output).
concurrency: Not applicable. All types are immutable or trivially copyable values safe to share across threads by value without synchronization.

unit_cases.precondition: A fixed non-empty byte sequence is available.
unit_cases.stimulus: Call canonical_digest twice on the identical byte sequence.
unit_cases.expected: Both calls return byte-identical 128-bit PermitId values.

unit_cases.precondition: Two distinct byte sequences are available.
unit_cases.stimulus: Compute canonical_digest on each sequence and measure output size.
unit_cases.expected: Each digest is 16 bytes; the two digests differ.

unit_cases.precondition: All eight LifecycleState values are enumerated.
unit_cases.expected: True only for closed, expired, revoked, and evidence_incomplete; false for declared, armed, active, closing.

unit_cases.precondition: A mask with a defined Action bit and a mask with an undefined bit are available.
unit_cases.expected: The defined-bit mask passes; the undefined-bit mask is reported as containing an undefined bit.

unit_cases.precondition: Tag values of length 63, length 64, with NUL, and with non-printable bytes are prepared.
unit_cases.expected: Length-63 printable ASCII without NUL is accepted; length 64, embedded NUL, and non-printable bytes are rejected.

unit_cases.precondition: A defined ActionMask and an undefined-bit mask are available.
unit_cases.expected: A defined mask returns a stable, non-empty name; a mask containing an undefined bit returns a distinct empty/unknown marker and is never named as a defined action.

static_checks.expected: clean (no diagnostic): all value types initialize every member.
clean (no diagnostic): digest and predicate helpers are marked [[nodiscard]].
clean (no diagnostic): array-typed parameters are passed by const reference or value only where trivial.
Diagnostic holds only enumerable codes and a numeric locator; no std::string, item, observation, or free-form member.
clean: header formatted with no diff.
Strict public-API documentation passes with no Doxygen warnings or errors.
